items.title: 23.7 Esters (acid aur alcohol se bane khushbudar compounds) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 23.7, printed pages 109-110 (PDF 112-113).

blocks.text: Esters carboxylic acids ke derivatives (un se bane compounds) hain jo carboxylic acids ke alcohols se reaction se milte hain. Alcohols aur carboxylic acids ke ulat (unlike), esters ke molecules aapas mein hydrogen bond nahi bana sakte. Isi liye in ke boiling points corresponding (milte julte) alcohols aur carboxylic acids se kam hain. Ethyl ethanoate (CH₃COOC₂H₅) ka boiling point 77 °C hai, yani yeh ethanoic acid aur ethanol se zyada volatile (jaldi bhaap banne wala) hai. Hydrogen bonds na hone ki wajah se esters paani mein kam ghulte hain ya bilkul nahi ghulte. Bohat se esters meethi, phalon jaisi khushbu wale liquids hain. Esters solvents (gholne wale liquids) ke taur par, aur fruit drinks (phalon ke sharbat) aur mithaiyon mein flavouring agents (zaiqa dene wali cheezen) ke taur par istemal hote hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke 77 °C boiling point ethyl ethanoate ki 'lower relative volatility' (kam volatility) dikhata hai. Ulta hai: kam boiling point ka matlab zyada volatility hai, is liye ethyl ethanoate ethanoic acid aur ethanol se zyada volatile hai. (Kitab mein do jumle dobara bhi chhape hain.)
Phalon ki khushbu aur zaiqa esters ki wajah se hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethyl ethanoate ethanoic acid se kam temperature par kyun ubalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Ester molecules mein O–H group nahi, is liye yeh aapas mein hydrogen bonds nahi bana sakte; sirf weak attraction forces (kheenchne wali forces) unhein jore rakhti hain, jo aasani se toot jati hain.

items: Esters: carboxylic acid + alcohol se bante hain.
Molecules ke beech hydrogen bonding nahi: kam boiling point (ethyl ethanoate 77 °C), zyada volatile, paani mein kam ghulte hain.
Phalon jaisi khushbu: solvents aur flavouring agents.
